answer: The wander holds work receipts rather than names, so the haven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
